cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Call It a Fair Win
cards.instruction: Get them to recognize the result as deserved rather than accidental, gifted, or manipulated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: In the quiz report, write that I earned the trophy. 'The questions suited Pat' isn't an account of how I won.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There were twelve bird questions. You keep birds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I studied them for six months. Put the preparation before the score, please; keeping a cage doesn't answer questions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody else knew it would be a bird round.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Neither did I. Write 'Pat's six months of study paid off'. Please don't replace the work with 'lucky' just because you didn't see me doing it.

reason: Remove the diffuse comparison and unnecessary old sport results; answer advance knowledge and dictate the relevant earned-credit wording.
